tallycode.description: Count code lines per language with source/test split, diff vs baseline, and beautiful dashboard exports.
tallycode.capabilities.untrustedWorkspac: TallyCode reads files in the workspace to count lines. Enable only in workspaces you trust.
tallycode.view.overview.name: Overview
tallycode.command.openDashboard.title: Open Dashboard
tallycode.command.countWorkspace.title: Count Workspace
tallycode.command.countDirectory.title: Count This Folder
tallycode.command.countFile.title: Count Current File
tallycode.command.saveBaseline.title: Save Current Result as Baseline
tallycode.command.clearBaseline.title: Clear Baseline
tallycode.command.exportReport.title: Export Report…
tallycode.command.statusBarMenu.title: Status Bar Menu
tallycode.config.useGitignore.descriptio: Honor every .gitignore file in the workspace when scanning.
tallycode.config.useFilesExclude.descrip: Merge VSCode's files.exclude into the scan exclude list.
tallycode.config.exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from scanning.
tallycode.config.maxFileSizeMB.descripti: Skip files larger than this many megabytes (0 = unlimited).
tallycode.config.maxOpenFiles.descriptio: Maximum concurrent file reads during a scan.
tallycode.config.useLspCalibration.descr: Use VSCode semantic tokens to calibrate comment/string detection on the active document (slower but more accurate).
tallycode.config.markerScanLines.descrip: Scan the first N lines of each file for test-marker regexes. Set to 0 to disable in-file marker detection.
tallycode.config.testRules.description: Overrides for the four-layer test classifier. The 'default' entry replaces built-in defaults; 'perLanguage' merges rules onto language ids.
tallycode.config.languages.description: Override or extend built-in language rules. Each key is a language id; values are partial LanguageRule objects.
tallycode.config.languageConfUri.descrip: Optional file:// URI to a JSON file containing additional language rules.
tallycode.config.statusBar.enabled.descr: Show TallyCode in the status bar with line counts for the active file.
tallycode.config.statusBar.format.descri: Status bar display: 'loc' (code only), 'code+comment' (both), or 'percent' (code % and comment %).
tallycode.config.statusBar.showLanguageI: Use a per-language codicon in the status bar instead of the generic line-numbered icon.
